text:
maria: Hey all — first day! I'm blocked: when I SSH to prod-jump via the bastion I see 'Permission denied (publickey)'. I think I wasn't added to 'infra-bastion' IAM group. Tried from home on Comcast, connected to VPN split-tunnel. Anyone to add me?

jamie: welcome! tagging @alex. Can you paste output of `ssh -v`? Also which username?

alex: @maria welcome! You should be in 'infra-bastion' and 'developers' groups. I'll check. ssh -v output?

maria: here's snippet:
```
debug1: Offering public key: /Users/maria/.ssh/id_ed25519
debug1: Server accepts key: pkalg ssh-ed25519
Permission denied (publickey)
```
username is maria.

alex: OK you're not in bastion group. Filed add request, but need approval from Eng Manager. pinging @olivia

olivia: +1 from me for infra-bastion access. also request label 'onboard-2026' for tracking.

alex: done. Also note some home NATs drop keys — if you still can't connect after group add, try:
```
ssh -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 maria@prod-jump
```
or
```
ssh -o PubkeyAcceptedKeyTypes=+ssh-ed25519 -v maria@prod-jump
```

maria: after IdentitiesOnly it works! :tada:

maria: one more q: do we need any extra VPC routes for internal registry? `docker pull` times out unless I go through bastion-proxy.

alex: registry is in private subnet only reachable from VPN or via bastion egress. For new hires we add temporary egress rule with tag `onboard-proxy` for 48h — I added it. For longer access file infra-access ticket with your manager and include `onboard-2026` label.

sam: FYI on macOS split-tunnel, add a resolver for internal domains:
```
# /etc/resolver/redwood
nameserver 10.20.1.2
search internal.redwood
```

maria: added resolver, docker pull succeeded. Anything else I should do?

olivia: enroll in hardware 2FA (KMS) and add your laptop to device registry. Welcome aboard!

oncall-bot: Note: temporary access label `onboard-2026` expires in 48h at 2026-03-25T12:00:00Z

maria: awesome — thanks everyone!!
